name: Wand of Magic Missiles

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 7 charges: Magic Missile, up to 3 charges for a level 3 casting.
text: Holding the wand, spend 1 or more of its 7 charges to cast Magic Missile. A single charge casts it at level 1, and each additional charge adds 1 to the spell's level, to a maximum of 3 charges in total. It recovers 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn; once you spend the final charge, roll 1d20, and on a 1 it crumbles to ash and is destroyed.
